form.vehicleConditionTip1: Select New if you bought a brand new vehicle from a dealership.
form.vehicleConditionTip2: Select Used if you bought a vehicle that's been driven by a previous owner (usually purchased from a dealership or a private seller).

form.estimateTip1: • Consider your weekly distance for driving to and from work, or school, plus any personal driving
form.estimateTip2: • Add these numbers, then multiply by 52
form.estimateTip3: • Now, add the number of kilometres you expect to drive for vacations or other short- or long-haul trips during the year

form.winterTires: Do you equip this vehicle with 4 winter tires from December 1st to March 31st every year?
form.antiTheftSystem: Is this vehicle equipped with a professionally installed, aftermarket, anti-theft tracking system or electronic engine immobilizer?
form.antiTheftWithin30Days: Will this vehicle be equipped with a professionally installed, aftermarket, anti-theft tracking system or electronic engine immobilizer within 30 days of your coverage start date?
form.antiTheftReq1: To ensure you're eligible for a policy discount and, in some cases, avoid potential premium increases:
form.antiTheftReq2: • Your anti-theft system must have been installed by a certified, professional technician. Factory installed anti-theft systems are not acceptable. • We recommend you keep the installation receipt as it may help in the event of vehicle theft.
form.lzAdvantagePromo: LZ Advantage is a voluntary usage-based insurance program that provides you with a personalized premium based on your driving behaviour. Safe driving habits could reward you with a discount of up to 30%, while riskier driving habits could lead to a surcharge of up to 30% on your premium. You'll also receive a one-time activation discount of 10% just for enrolling, and you can opt out at any time. Conditions apply.
form.lzAdvantageDesc1: LZ Advantage is a voluntary usage-based insurance program that provides you with a personalized premium based on your driving behaviour. Safe driving habits could reward you with a discount of up to 30%, while riskier driving habits could lead to a surcharge of up to 30% on your premium.
form.lzAdvantageDesc2: To determine your eligibility for a discount or surcharge, we'll assess your driving behaviour and give you a rating out of 5 stars. To accurately rate you, we collect certain information about your driving habits including (but not limited to) braking and acceleration; your speed; the time of day you drive; how you take corners; if you use your phone; and how long you drive.
form.lzAdvantageDesc3: The first assessment will be completed 6 months from the start date of your policy, and you'll need to record at least 30 trips by that time. Future assessments will happen every 12 months, and in that time, you'll need to drive a minimum of 1000 km to maintain your eligibility.
form.lzAdvantageDesc4: Your projected discount or surcharge will be available to view in the TD Insurance app, so you'll know in advance how you're going to be assessed.
form.lzAdvantageDesc5: In the event you opt-out or are removed from the program, any surcharge you incurred will remain on your policy, while any discount you earned will be removed. In the event you re-enroll in the future, you may receive the same discount you earned during your last enrollment.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security
privacy.introduction: At LZ Insurance, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application and services.
privacy.personalInfo1: Name, email address, phone number, mailing address
privacy.personalInfo2: Date of birth, marital status, gender
privacy.personalInfo3: Driver's license number and province, identification documents
privacy.insuranceInfo3: Vehicle, property, and other insured asset information
privacy.usageData1: App usage statistics, features accessed, time spent
privacy.usageData2: Device information, IP address, location data (with your permission for LZ Advantage)
privacy.usePurpose1: To provide insurance services including quotes, policy management, and claims processing
privacy.usePurpose2: To calculate premiums and assess risk based on your information and driving behavior
privacy.usePurpose3: To communicate with you about your policies, claims, payments, and important updates
privacy.usePurpose4: To improve our services, develop new features, and personalize your experience
privacy.encryptionDesc: We use industry-standard encryption (AES-256) to protect your data both in transit and at rest. All communications between your device and our servers are secured with Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocols.
privacy.accessControlsDesc: We implement role-based access controls (RBAC) to ensure only authorized personnel have access to your information. All employees and service providers undergo background checks and sign confidentiality agreements.
privacy.auditsDesc: We conduct regular security audits and vulnerability assessments to identify and address potential security weaknesses. We work with third-party security experts to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.
privacy.mfaDesc: We require multi-factor authentication (MFA) for account access to add an extra layer of security. This includes password verification combined with SMS or email verification codes.
privacy.rightAccessDesc: You have the right to access and view your personal information at any time through your profile section in the app.
privacy.rightCorrectionDesc: You can update or correct your personal information directly in the app through your profile settings.
privacy.rightDeletionDesc: You may request deletion of your personal information, subject to legal and regulatory requirements. Contact our Privacy Office to submit a deletion request.
privacy.rightPortabilityDesc: You can request a copy of your personal information in a portable format. Contact our Privacy Office for assistance.
privacy.rightObjectionDesc: You can object to certain uses of your information, such as marketing communications. You can manage these preferences in your account settings.
privacy.sharingPolicy1: We do not sell your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes. We only share your information with service providers who need it to provide insurance services (e.g., claims adjusters, repair shops, legal counsel).
privacy.sharingPolicy2: We may disclose your information when required by law, such as responding to legal process, protecting our rights, or complying with insurance regulations.
privacy.sharingPolicy3: In the event of a business transfer (merger, acquisition), your information may be transferred as part of the transaction, but your privacy rights will be maintained.
privacy.retentionPolicy1: We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide insurance services and comply with legal and regulatory requirements. This typically includes the duration of your policies plus a statutory retention period.
privacy.retentionPolicy2: When information is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it in accordance with our data retention policies.
privacy.cookiesDesc1: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your app experience, analyze usage patterns, and improve our services. Location tracking is only used with your explicit permission for the LZ Advantage driving score program.
privacy.cookiesDesc2: You can control cookie preferences and disable location tracking through your device settings or the app settings. Disabling these features may limit certain functionality.
privacy.childrenDesc: Our services are not directed to children under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe we have inadvertently collected information from a child, please contact us immediately.
privacy.changesDesc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will notify you of significant changes through the app or by email. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.breachPolicy1: In the unlikely event of a data breach affecting your personal information, we have a comprehensive incident response plan. We will notify affected users and relevant authorities within 72 hours as required by law.
privacy.breachPolicy2: Notifications will include details about what happened, what information was affected, steps we're taking to address the breach, and actions you can take to protect yourself.
privacy.breachPolicy3: We will provide guidance on steps you can take, such as monitoring your accounts, changing passwords, or placing fraud alerts on your credit reports.
privacy.contactDesc: If you have questions, concerns, or requests regarding your privacy rights or this Privacy Policy, please contact our Privacy Office:
